newsitem.title: USA: Vista 2000 says Axxess buys subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Vista 2000 says Axxess buys subsidiary.

text.p: Vista 2000 Inc said Monday Axxess Technologies Inc agreed to buy the keymaking machine, letters, numbers and signs manufacturing and related business of its wholly owned subsidiary, American Consumer Products Inc.
The company did not disclose a purchase price on the deal.
Vista will retain the ACPI Warren Pet division as well as Boss Manufacturing Inc and Boss Balloon Inc.
The deal is subject to regulatory approval.
Axxess makes and distributes key duplicating systems, cutting machines, key blanks and related products.
